nodes.title: director33: 36 lessons on release 56's code (6 live, 3 staged), 9 Opus judges by hand: 3 topics pass every gate line (c5-t03, c6-ch07-t01, staged c4-ch01-t02); three live lessons fail on one turn each (a drawing after "no other drawing"); live c5-t01 fails on worked-example boards and a safety turn fired in it; the two new staged lessons fail on script data

After director33: the no-picture turn keeps the screen; the own reason only after its named wrong answer with no stand-in; every sentence after an answer is said over a board that shows it; the checker refuses what got through; the question cap counts what the child hears; staged batches stop until two runs in a row pass

The build order (to-brain 049 B2: the hint over its own board after the no-picture line) and the judges' rule (H2: a drawing after that line is a contradiction) were both written by main and contradicted each other; three live lessons failed the gate on the row, which was in the dry run for hours unread against the rule

Taking the answer off a posing board leaves the sentences said after the answer over a board that denies them: a step confirmed "4 gap" over two gaps, a value stated under a "?"; every read looked at each board under its question only

A card's own reason said after any miss, where the card names no wrong answer, speaks of an answer the child never gave: fourteen rows in five topics; where the wrong answer is named it speaks to the child every time (c6 7 of 7, listening 4)

The two-turns cap did not count the short ask, the Hindi form, a picture turn or an aside reply as the question: runs of three and four remain in seven topics, and "Ab tum batao." after a park line is heard as an invitation to the side-topic

A right answer "5 gaps mein kaatungi" in the live number-line lesson set off the safeguarding turn twice (the model's read of the child's line; safety frozen): the second accept form in two runs, and the verb of every fractions lesson

Saying the card's unsaid hint over the hint's own board after "I have no other drawing of this" (to-brain 049 B2): a new drawing appears under that line and the card's board is gone when she invites the answer; five lessons, the gate line in three live ones
Letting any miss stand in for the named wrong answer at a card that names none, so that its own reason could be help: she tells a child who said 7 that "3/4 does not mean 3 gaps"

md.measurements: - `ms-r8-director33` (2026-11-23): 36 lessons (the six live scripts, each rewritten this round, and three staged scripts: `c4-maths-ch01-t02` in its third rewrite, `c4-maths-ch06-t01` and `c6-maths-ch07-t03` new; × steady, stuck, offtopic, steering), Director only, reactive rule-based child typing Latin Hinglish, on int/r6 integration 90 (`0f89b3ca5`, release 56's code), one invocation, 2,871 model calls, about $2.14. Live predicate check exit 1 on two rows only (a safeguarding turn in steady c5-t01); every other gated predicate 0. Nine Opus judges at high effort, one per topic, four lessons each by hand, against a prompt whose 44 clauses were fixed before the run. By hand: 0 misgrades in 938 keyed answers; false keys: one sentence in 4 rows of the new staged c6-ch07-t03, 0 elsewhere; words against the board: 0 in c5-t03, c6-ch07-t01 and c4-ch01-t02, 1 each in c4, c5-t02 and c6 (the no-picture turn, by main's ruling 1), 7 in c5-t01 (6 script, 1 that turn), 13 in c4-ch06-t01, 10 in c6-ch07-t03; unsaid boards (strict): 4 in c4-ch06-t01, 0 elsewhere. Axes (floor 3.5): listening 3.5 in eight and 4 in c6; register 3.5 in all nine; worked example 3.5 to 4; class level 4; screen and speech 3 in c5-t01 and the two new staged topics, 3.5 to 4.5 elsewhere; promises 3.5 to 4. Pass: c5-ch02-t03, c6-ch07-t01, c4-ch01-t02 (staged). Fail: c4-ch05-t01, c5-ch02-t02, c6-ch06-t01 (one row each, code), c5-ch02-t01 (script boards), c4-ch06-t01 and c6-ch07-t03 (staged, script). 45 picture requests, 0 answered with a key (director32: 3); 36 Hindi requests, no switch line without its form; 74 turns ended on the invitation. One safeguarding turn fired on a right answer ("5 gaps mein kaatungi"). Not measured: Devanagari replies, a real voice, a real child. Files: `evals/hybrid-side-by-side/results/2026-11-23-director33/`; judgement `docs/design/round7/judgements/director33-2026-11-23.md`.
md.decisions: - `dc-r8-director33` (2026-11-23, main, supersedes `dc-r8-director32`): twelve items in `docs/design/round7/judgements/director33-2026-11-23.md`. In short: (1) release 57 rewords the question that invited "kaatungi"; (2) when nothing is left to draw, the board that is up stays up, help follows only if it owns no board, and a view equal to the board counts as spent; (3) a card's own reason is help only after its named wrong answer, with no stand-in, and the checker refuses the mark on a card that names none (narrows `dc-r8-own-reason-after-its-miss`); (4) every sentence said after an answer is said over a board that shows it: asked steps and "?" cards carry answer boards; (5) the checker refuses a "?" card with no answer board, a confirmation that counts what its board does not draw, a fraction comparison its arithmetic denies, a given that changes between turns, one friend's name on several people; (6) the question cap counts the short ask, the Hindi form, picture turns and aside replies, and the invitation is never said after a park line or with no help; (7) a Hindi request at a card with no form is acknowledged with a line that promises only easier words; (8) the return never asks for what the aside said; (9) Learning 022 by row, and `c4-maths-ch01-t02` goes live with four lines changed; (10) the record; (11) each rule the judges count by is read against its build note and against the dry rows before a run; (12) director34. Clauses 43 and 42 fired: no further lesson comes out of hold until two judged runs in a row have no live lesson failing a gate line for a cause in code, and until the checker refuses each kind in (5). **Why:** the round's listening items worked where built to the letter (0 keys at picture requests, no broken Hindi promise, help that names the child's answer) and the failures have four authors, three of them main: an order against its own rule, a board changed without reading what is said over it, a stand-in ruled from dry lessons. **What would reverse it:** per item, in the judgement; the general one: a third run in which a passing lesson fails on what the round's own build introduced makes rounds change code and scripts in separate runs.
md.rejected:
- `rj-r8-help-board-after-no-picture-line` (2026-11-23): **tried** (to-brain 049 B2 as ordered and built) answering a picture request with nothing left to draw by the authored line "I have no other drawing of this", then the card's unsaid hint over the hint's own board. **What broke:** a new drawing appears some forty characters after she says there is none, and the card's own board is off the screen when the turn ends on "Ab tum batao."; five of nine steering lessons, counted as a contradiction by the rule main had given the judges, and the only failing gate line in three live lessons. Replaced by `dc-r8-director33` item 2.
- `rj-r8-own-reason-after-any-miss` (2026-11-23): **tried** (main's ruling while to-brain 049 B3 was built: `dc-r8-own-reason-after-its-miss`, its clause "where the card names no wrong answer, any miss") letting any miss stand in so that such a card's marked reason could be its second help. **What broke:** the reason was written against one mistake and is said to children who made another: "3/4 ka matlab 3 gap nahi hai" to a child who answered 7; fourteen rows in five topics, and the gated predicate read 0 because it shared the ruling. Replaced by `dc-r8-director33` item 3.
